## SK Hynix Backs $38B HBM Capacity Buildout Amid Valuation Discount Debate

A $38B HBM buildout commitment by the leading supplier defines the demand expectations embedded in capex plans; if AI infrastructure spend decelerates, this level of investment creates significant cycle overhang risk — but if demand holds, the discount thesis becomes compelling.

- SK Hynix is committing to a $38 billion HBM capacity buildout.
- Coverage asks whether the stock's valuation discount is too harsh given the scale of investment.
- Investment size signals strong internal conviction in sustained HBM demand.
- High-confidence tag on HBM competitive landscape and AI infrastructure capex.
